subject.title: feat(slack): Support Slack RTS (Real-Time Search) API via assistant action tokens

question: Should OpenClaw add Slack RTS via `assistant.search.context`, and what token containment, read-target policy, and scope rules should the Slack plugin enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but event-scoped Slack action tokens plus workspace-wide search are a security and product boundary that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a narrow RTS contract
options.body: Implement `assistant.search.context` inside the Slack plugin with event-scoped token containment, explicit search authorization, docs, focused tests, and redacted live Slack proof.

options.title: Consolidate Slack search first
options.body: Define one Slack search contract that covers RTS and user-token search before accepting implementation work.

options.title: Defer workspace search
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until maintainers are ready to own the token and privacy model.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow RTS contract
recommendation.body: Implement `assistant.search.context` inside the Slack plugin with event-scoped token containment, explicit search authorization, docs, focused tests, and redacted live Slack proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the clearest recent Slack assistant/action history and authored the related broad Slack action-parity PR.
